caption:
Mumbai had more of the ball. Bengaluru had the goals.

Bengaluru FC beat Mumbai City 2-0 at the Sree Kanteerava tonight to go top of the ISL with 13 points from 5 games. Sunil Chhetri captained the side in his 200th ISL appearance.

Why it went Bengaluru's way: Mumbai had 51% of the ball and 16 shots to Bengaluru's 9. But it was 0-0 at the break and Borja Martinez scored a penalty in the 57th minute. Substitute Ryan Williams made it 2-0 in the 85th.

Mumbai, in their first game under new coach Ashvir Singh Johal, are still without a win in 5. Bengaluru are one point clear of Mohun Bagan and NorthEast United can go above them with a win over FC Goa on Saturday.

Can Bengaluru stay top all season? Tell us below.
